infantry: Historical role: infantry fought on foot and held ground. This game uses a stylized musket-era silhouette.
scout: Historical role: scouts gathered information and reconnoitered routes ahead of the main army.
cavalry: Historical role: mounted troops provided speed, pursuit and reconnaissance.
artillery: Historical role: field guns supported armies with concentrated fire.
fleet: Historical role: naval forces protected routes and contested sea control. Amphibious transport is a future feature.
air: Historical role: military aviation came much later than the starting calendar. C.A.R.S. deliberately mixes periods; its air service is a game abstraction.
